page.overview:
Who is Bina?

While most Amani are warriors, Bina left her home planet to learn and explore the galaxy, and after some time, she made Black Spire her homebase. Bina gave a young Salju and her pet therii, Elee, advice on how to brush Elee's teeth and her preferred diet.

During 34 ABY, Bina procured and attempted to sell a collection of Loralora birds, but Izal Garsea and Julen Rakab accidentally set them free as a distraction. Moradi, a spy and recruiter for the Resistance, did not consider Bina a viable candidate for the movement due to her entrepreneurial endeavors. While Bina may not support the Resistance, she does work to educate the children that come through the Black Spire Outpost Market. She wrote a small workbook called Bina's Guide to the Creatures of Batuu filled with pictures and details about the local fauna that call Batuu their home. The guide was available for all younglings who stopped by her storefront. Bina was not present when Eloc Throno visited Black Spire Outpost as she had left for one of her personal adventures.

Bina is one of many shopkeeper characters created for the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge theme park land. In February 2020, the Creature Stall began offering a free scavenger-hunt activity book, Bina's Guide to the Creatures of Batuu, for children ages 10 and under. After stamping the books at each location, the player would be rewarded with a special coaster token.
